decisions.title: Transcription of the Round 12 User decision message (verbatim) and ratification of the five pending delegated P10 decisions
decisions.decision: The User's Round 12 decision message, received 2026-10-16, is transcribed verbatim between the BEGIN/END markers in the evidence array below. The message resolves all nine lines of the Round 12 decision interface: the five pending delegated decisions DEC-7101, DEC-7102, DEC-7103, DEC-7104 and DEC-7110 are each ratified at OPTION A (their full meaning is defined in sps2/decisions/P10-DELEGATED-DECISIONS.json, which this ratification updates in place); SLICE-AUTHORING is AUTHORIZE (the agent may author sps2/project/SLICE-P10-01.json at acceptance_state DRAFT with honest placeholders); APPROVAL-MECHANISM is OPTION A (a fresh, explicit User approval act is required when the gate passes; D-P10-8's contents-approval does not carry over into inventory.user_approval); SEMANTICS is ADOPT (the six runtime-gate semantics designs are adopted, with their stated limitations: content-integrity/provenance, not cryptographic authenticity or human authentication); PUBLICATION is DEFER (Home content publication is explicitly deferred and is not authorized). The ratification of the five delegated decisions is executed in place in sps2/decisions/P10-DELEGATED-DECISIONS.json; the slice authoring is executed as sps2/project/SLICE-P10-01.json; the semantics adoption is executed as sps2/decisions/P10-GATE-SEMANTICS-ADOPTION.json; the evidence placeholder is created as sps2/evidence/P10-EVIDENCE.json. This record changes no file itself and is not authority to change any file beyond those four executions, each of which is scoped by the transcribed message.
decisions.reason: The User's Round 12 decisions exist only in the session transcript, which is untracked and lost on a fresh clone. Under .sps/GOVERNANCE.md section 5, decision records exist so that future agents do not re-litigate settled decisions because they did not know why or whether they were made. The repository's established remedy (DEC-0031, for the identical DP-10 failure mode) is a verbatim transcription into the governance-native decision contract. The author is an agent, not a User; under .sps/GOVERNANCE.md the Approval axis is 'User only', so this record can only transcribe an approval that already exists in the User's message and can never create one.

alternatives.option: Paraphrase the message instead of transcribing it verbatim
alternatives.why_not_chosen: A paraphrase is the agent's voice, not the User's; the repository's evidence standard (established by DEC-0031's provenance-limitation analysis) treats verbatim User text as strictly better evidence, and the absence of verbatim text is precisely the defect DP-10 records. Paraphrasing would recreate that defect knowingly.

alternatives.option: Do not transcribe; rely on the in-place ratification blocks in P10-DELEGATED-DECISIONS.json
alternatives.why_not_chosen: The ratification blocks quote the decision lines but not the whole message (the SLICE-AUTHORING, APPROVAL-MECHANISM, SEMANTICS and PUBLICATION lines have no home in the delegated record). The full message, including its deferrals, must be durable somewhere; this record is that somewhere.

alternatives.option: Wait for the message to arrive through a tracked channel (e.g. a committed file the User edits)
alternatives.why_not_chosen: No such channel exists in this repository's workflow; every prior User authorization (DEC-0031's source included) arrived in-session and required exactly this transcription remedy. Waiting would leave the ratifications uncited for the whole life of the branch.

approval.basis: TRANSCRIBED, NOT ORIGINATED. The User approval recorded here is the Round 12 decision message itself, transcribed verbatim in the evidence array between the BEGIN/END markers. decided_by is 'User' because the message is the User's own words, reproduced character-for-character; no verbatim text is reconstructed or paraphrased. decided_at 2026-10-16 is the date the message was received. This record originates no approval and grants no authority; it preserves an existing one. The scope of what the message authorizes is stated in the decision field and is bounded by the message's own lines: implementation, commit and push are NOT among the nine lines, and remain unauthorized until separately granted.

non_goals: Not an approval. This record creates no User approval; it transcribes one that already exists in the User's Round 12 message.
Not authority to implement. None of the nine decision lines authorizes a renderer, build, harness, backend, or any other implementation code; PUBLICATION is DEFER and no line grants implementation.
Not authority for any git stage, commit, push, publish or deploy. The message contains no such grant, and none is inferred.

Not a change to the delegated decisions' meaning. DEC-7101..7104 and DEC-7110 are ratified exactly as written in sps2/decisions/P10-DELEGATED-DECISIONS.json; no alternative, caveat or reinterpretation is introduced.
Not a resolution of CONF-001, UQ-ATT-2, KI-15, the SPEC-2 D1-D5 decisions, or any other open item outside the nine lines.

Not a claim that the transcription proves the human author's identity. The transcription preserves the message's content; whether a given session message was in fact sent by the human User remains a session-level fact outside the repository's ability to verify (the UQ-ATT-2 boundary, unchanged).
